name: Takeuchi Ryouji
source: Was working at a failing country club restaurant, when all of the sudden he is told it will close down. He is recruited along with Ayano to try and save the club with the new themed reastaurant. A lot of his initial duties are simply watching the girls in lingerie so they can get used to it. Gets beat up by Ayano or teased by the others quite often.
